text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 Plus radio station's noon news report on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Lithuanian peace-keeping platoon LITPLA 6 left for military training in Viborg in Denmark. The platoon will go on peace-keeping mission in Bosnia in October.
- Lithuania is only in its first round of negotiations with the World Trade organisation while Estonia and Latvia have got much further in their talks.
